title: Implement schema validation for configuration and data artifacts
problem_statement: Current codebase includes JSON and YAML schema files but lacks explicit enforcement of validation, risking data integrity and runtime errors.
risk_if_unaddressed: Invalid or malformed configuration and data artifacts may cause failures or inconsistent behavior in production.
suggested_approach: Integrate JSON schema validation libraries in the code paths that load and process configuration and data artifacts. Add automated tests to verify validation enforcement.
success_criteria: All configuration and data artifacts are validated against their schemas before use.
Automated tests cover schema validation scenarios.
No runtime errors due to invalid artifacts in staging environment.

provenance.evidence: Schema file present without detected validation usage

title: Refactor modules with high import counts to reduce complexity
problem_statement: Modules such as agents.analyst have many imports, indicating potential high complexity and tight coupling.
risk_if_unaddressed: High complexity may lead to maintainability challenges and increased defect rates.
suggested_approach: Analyze module dependencies and refactor to separate concerns, reduce import dependencies, and improve modularity.
success_criteria: Reduced number of imports per module where feasible.
No regression in functionality as verified by tests.
